title: e-Services
description: Online permit request services of the Office of the Royal Society: read the regulations, download the forms and submit documents by email

blocks.heading: e-Services
blocks.lead: Online permit request services of the Office of the Royal Society: read the regulations, download the forms and submit documents by email

blocks.heading: Available services
blocks.lead: Read the regulation for the service you need, download the request form, then send your documents by email.

items.title: Printing and publishing
items.body: Request for permission to print and publish publications, electronic media, electronic data and other media of the Office of the Royal Society

items.title: Licence to print and sell
items.body: Request for the right to print and sell books produced by the Office of the Royal Society for publication and sale

items.title: Read the regulations
items.body: Check the criteria and conditions set out in the regulation for the service you need.

items.title: Fill in the request form
items.body: Download the form (PDF) and complete all the required details.

items.title: Send documents by email
items.body: Send the form with supporting documents to saraban@orst.go.th. Accepted files: .pdf, .doc and .docx, up to 10MB.

items.title: Follow up on progress
items.body: Ask about the status of your request by email or telephone. Contact details are on the Track Request page.
